name: Thickening sky
story: Still fine underneath, but the sky is turning: mares' tails in the morning, a grey veil spreading from the southwest by afternoon, the wind backing south. The radio is talking about the weekend.
forecast: Fair, high cloud thickening from the southwest. South 6 kt, 10-12 kt by evening. Pressure falling. A FRONT reaches the island the day after tomorrow: a southeast gale, rain.
